title: feature: option for summary instead of rows  in .gander_dims
description:
Hi there,

I forked it because I really enjoy using it and I wanted to try it with summary instead of rows.

The code is rather hacky but it gives you an impression.

I got a few notes when running devtools::check, but they were already in it before my changes.

Don't feel pressured to actually review it or merge it in. Of course, if you would have any suggestions / pointers that would be greatly appreciated.

title: allow users to adjust dims of described data
description:
Closes #44.

* Implements `.gander_dims` option to allow users to choose the default numbers of rows and columns they'd like to describe.
* Increases the default number of columns from 20 to 100.

title: transition to new ellmer config interface
description:
* transitions `.gander_fn` and `.gander_args` to `.gander_chat`, which takes an ellmer Chat like `options(.gander_chat = ellmer::chat_claude())`, as suggested in tidyverse/ellmer#175.
* transitions away from having a "default" model. this has historically been Claude, though i don't know if that's wise thinking longer-term. ideally, ellmer has some package option that allows users to choose a default model for extensions to use (see tidyverse/ellmer#175), but in the meantime, i'd like to either not have a default model _or_ cycle through possible keys users might have configured (Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub PAT), but the second option feels risky privacy-wise and also just spends money on the users' behalf (besides `chat_github()`, at least for now).
